scope: Small deployment gate reliability extension; no original P0 acceptance claimed.

observed_failure.stage: Wait for independent exact-main checks, before image build

recovery.action: A single failed-job rerun after independent gates completed and fresh successful read-only API lookups

implementation: At most three consecutive retries for recognized transient read-only HTTP/transport errors; no deadline reset.
Request timeout min(15 seconds, remaining budget); poll/retry sleeps clipped to remaining budget; late returned successes refused.
Retry-After honored; conservative 60-second wait for429 without it; malformed Retry-After stops safely.

Permanent/auth/certificate/DNS/malformed errors and actual failed gates stop immediately. Exception type and validated status are retained; body, token, URL and arbitrary exception messages are omitted.
Only exact named github-actions checks with requested head_sha qualify; entire pagination restarts after a read failure.
Highest validated run ID supersedes older states even when new started_at is null; conflicting duplicate states are rejected irrespective of order.

review_and_tests.environment: Local Linux, standard library, no network
review_and_tests.independent_source_review: Completed against both listed file hashes; no remaining concrete blocker.
pre_fix_controls: Page request timeout could exceed remaining budget.
Newest queued rerun could hide behind old success.
Conflicting duplicate check rows could produce order-dependent false success.

publication_gates: Native exact proposed-merge tests and protected hosted checks for this two-file source change are separate; final results recorded in containing PR before authorized merge.
limits: Original failure HTTP status is unknown; this does not prove that particular error was transient.
Inherited urllib DNS/body reads are not forcibly interrupted by an absolute transport deadline. Admission, waits, timeout values and late-result rejection are bounded, but MJ-REQ-004 remains PARTIAL.
